surface_description_notes: Bespoke asphalt resurfacing executed by Tarmac (CRH) under Dromo consultant Jarno Zaffelli in June-August 2019 (FIM/FIA homologated 22 August 2019). Per Pirelli 30 June 2026 official preview, the surface is not abrasive, has relatively low roughness (2/5), and provides high baseline grip (4/5) with low track evolution (2/5) due to continuous year-round two- and four-wheel racing.

surface_version_and_validity.derivation_method: Dated official notice (22 August 2019) and Tarmac project report (17 July 2019); no subsequent full-circuit resurfacing reported through July 2026.

surface_abrasiveness_score.derivation_method: Pirelli 1-5 ordinal rating: abrasiveness = 2.0 ('The track surface is not abrasive and has relatively low roughness'). Replaces the 3.8 synthetic example value from the framework doc.

surface_grip_baseline_score.derivation_method: Pirelli 1-5 ordinal rating: surface grip = 4.0 ('It already offers a good level of grip thanks to the continuous use of the circuit throughout the year').

bumpiness_index_score.derivation_method: 2019 resurfacing eliminated prior drainage bumps, but no quantitative 1-5 bumpiness score is published by Pirelli; preserved as null.

track_evolution_parameters.derivation_method: Calibration excluded from this task. Initialised to declared neutral defaults (amplitude = 0.0 s, decay = 20.0 laps) per Table 4.3 missing_policy USE_DECLARED_DEFAULT.
